title: Gas Safe Register UK Business Search

location.title: Town or postcode
location.description: One UK town or postcode. If a town is ambiguous, enter Town, County (for example, London, Middlesex).

maxResults.title: Maximum unique businesses
maxResults.description: Maximum unique businesses to return, deduplicated by registration number. The Actor automatically reads enough listing pages (about 10 businesses per page) to reach this count, up to 250.

useUkResidentialProxy.title: Use UK residential proxy
useUkResidentialProxy.description: Route source requests through the configured UK residential proxy.

browserProfile.title: Browser profile
browserProfile.description: Managed browser profile for source compatibility.

allowUnblockerCertificateException.title: Allow isolated Unblocker certificate exception
allowUnblockerCertificateException.description: Disabled unless explicitly enabled for an isolated diagnostic.

loadPageAssets.title: Load page assets
loadPageAssets.description: Load optional images, media, and fonts.

settleSeconds.title: Homepage settling time
settleSeconds.description: Wait for homepage scripts before starting a search.

locationCounty.title: County for ambiguous towns
locationCounty.description: Optional county used to resolve an ambiguous town.

maxPages.title: Listing pages per location
maxPages.description: Internal safety ceiling; the result-count limit stops the crawl earlier. API callers may supply a lower cap.

includeEngineers.title: Include engineers
includeEngineers.description: Collect engineer names, status and public contact details. Turn off for a faster business-only search.

includeQualifications.title: Include qualifications
includeQualifications.description: Collect Natural gas, LPG and Building regulations qualifications. Requires Include engineers; adds time and cost.

maxEngineerPages.title: Engineer pages per business
maxEngineerPages.description: Maximum engineer listing pages to read per business.

maxEngineersPerBusiness.title: Engineers per business
maxEngineersPerBusiness.description: Maximum engineers to include per business.

requestDelayMillis.title: Navigation delay (ms)
requestDelayMillis.description: Minimum delay between top-level browser navigations.

operation.title: API operation
operation.description: API-only value: searchBusinesses, searchBusinessesBasic, getBusinessEngineers, or the equivalent snake_case endpoint name.

registrationNumber.title: Business registration number
registrationNumber.description: Required only for the getBusinessEngineers API operation.
